meaning: The galaxies of Cosmicflows-4 at every zoom: the whole field, then the nested levels around the Milky Way, each adding galaxies as its region fills the view.
basis: Presentation choice: the field is drawn whole within 100 Mpc, half its radius; each level starts to appear when the view's half-width at the Milky Way shrinks to the level's radius, so its edge is off screen, and is whole when it reaches the next level's radius; the 10 Mpc level is whole at 3 Mpc, where the Local Group catalogue takes over.
